Special Purpose Limited Tender (SPLT): i) The base date for working out price variation shall be the last date of bid submission. ii) As per CMM provisions, bid extension/auto-extension is not permissible in case of SPLT te nders. However, since the GeM portal does not provide an option to disable the auto- extens ion feature, the minimum number of bids required for disabling auto-extension shall be kept as 01 (one). In case the bid is auto-extended due to non-receipt of any bid, the bid shall be c ancelled. iii) As per CMM, there is no provision for seeking clarification or shortfall documents in case o f SPLT tenders; however, the GeM portal does not provide an option to disable this feature. Accordingly, a period of (02) two days for seeking clarification shall be enabled on the GeM p ortal, though no clarification or shortfall document shall be sought. iv) As the GeM portal does not provide the option for incorporating EMD provision in tenders where the bid duration period is less than 07 days, the requirement of submission of EMD by the bidders shall be specified in the Buyer Added Text based ATC clauses on the GeM portal . v) Participation of newly formed JV/Consortium shall not be permitted for bidding, as formati on of a JV/Consortium and preparation of requisite documents requires considerable time, w hich shall defeat the purpose of the tender. vi) Tenders shall be invited on GeM Portal https://gem.gov.in. vii) All working Contractors /Contractors who have been awarded similar nature of work in the last 3 years in NCL Subsidiary, shall be allowed to participate. Note: The number of prospective bidders in Limited Tender Enquiry should be mo re than three. viii) It shall be single cover system in which Bidder shall submit letter of bid, financial capacity ( evidence of working capital as 20% of the estimated cost), price bid and any other document required to prove MSE, Make in India status, etc., as per chapter 3 of CMM. ix) Bid shall be opened after 05 (five) days from the date of publication. Bidders shall get 5 x 24 h ours to submit the bid. No extension of bid submission end date shall be allowed and bid will be opened on the scheduled date & time as mentioned in the GeM Bid Document. x) The work may be awarded, if the offered price is justified. No technical clarification / short fall documents are to be sought. xi) The issuance & communication of LOA to the L-1 bidder/generation of contract on GeM Portal sh all constitute execution of contract/agreement. The Contractor will have to commence the work within 05 days of issuance of LOA . xii) The EMD/Bid Security as well as Performance Security Deposit (PSD) shall be applicable as per the existing provisions. However, no payment shall be made without submission of PSD and execution of formal agreement. xiii) All other provisions of relevant chapter of CMM shall be applicable. xiv) No extension (additional financial impact and / or additional time period considering hindra nces) shall be allowed in such cases. xv) TAA as per DoP shall be approving authority for award of service/work. Note: Other relevant provisions of GFR 2017 (Rule 162) shall apply. .
